EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows classic para-disubstituted benzene features: an intense ring-breathing band at 1004 cm⁻¹ and a strong para C–H out-of-plane band at ~830 cm⁻¹. A strong C=O near 1700 cm⁻¹ and an aromatic C=C at 1600 cm⁻¹ match an aromatic aldehyde. Crucially, bands at 619 and 653 cm⁻¹ indicate aryl C–Cl stretches, favoring p-chlorobenzaldehyde over fluoro analogs (which would emphasize higher-frequency C–F stretches). The 3073 cm⁻¹ band fits aromatic C–H stretching; 1167/1206 cm⁻¹ are consistent with in-plane C–H/C–C modes of a para-disubstituted ring.
